about_short_description.short_description: Autumn Labs is a platform for manufacturing observability and operations

product.name: Autumn Labs Realtime
product.description: A platform for real-time monitoring and control of factory robots, test stations, and industrial arms to track yield, throughput, and downtime.

product.name: Factory Metrics
product.description: A system that provides real-time statistical process control (SPC) metrics and tracks equipment states and product history in manufacturing.

product.name: Station Integration
product.description: A service that enables quick setup and integration of any factory station or equipment into the Autumn Labs platform.

product.name: Multi-Architecture Integrations
product.description: A capability to connect and monitor various types of factory stations and equipment through a unified platform.

product.name: Alerts and Notifications
product.description: A system that provides instant alerts for factory stations and metrics to notify users of issues or deviations.
